name: Tendou Motoya
source:
One day, a man suddenly arrived as the acting principal of the school.

He used to be a politician, but resigned from his position as a legislator due to certain circumstances.

Since then, he had been using the connections and information he had cultivated during his time as a politician to hold positions in various companies, but this time, he took on the role of acting principal at Seiryu Girls' Academy for a specific purpose.

He is lecherous and still full of energy.
He had many mistresses during his time as a politician.

[Translated from [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonokizuna/chara6.html]the official site[/url]]
